name: CI/CD Pipeline Notes Application

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop

  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  AUTH_IMAGE: yourdockerhub/auth-service
  NOTES_IMAGE: yourdockerhub/notes-service
  GATEWAY_IMAGE: yourdockerhub/gateway

jobs:

####################################################
# QUALITY
####################################################

  quality:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        service:
          - auth-service
          - notes-service

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.service }}

    steps:

      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: 8.3
          extensions: mbstring, pdo_mysql, redis
          coverage: none

      - name: Copy .env
        run: |
          if [ -f .env.example ]; then
            cp .env.example .env
          fi

      - name: Install Composer Dependencies
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Generate Application Key
        run: php artisan key:generate

      - name: Run Laravel Pint
        run: vendor/bin/pint --test

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: php artisan test --testsuite=Unit

      - name: Run Feature Tests
        run: php artisan test --testsuite=Feature

      - name: Generate Swagger Documentation
        run: php artisan l5-swagger:generate

####################################################
# BUILD
####################################################

  build:

    needs: quality

    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

####################################################
# AUTH IMAGE
####################################################

      - name: Build Auth Image

        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5

        with:
          context: ./auth-service
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.AUTH_IMAGE }}:latest
            ${{ env.AUTH_IMAGE }}:${{ github.sha }}

####################################################
# NOTES IMAGE
####################################################

      - name: Build Notes Image

        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5

        with:
          context: ./notes-service
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.NOTES_IMAGE }}:latest
            ${{ env.NOTES_IMAGE }}:${{ github.sha }}

####################################################
# GATEWAY IMAGE
####################################################

      - name: Build Gateway Image

        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5

        with:
          context: ./gateway
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.GATEWAY_IMAGE }}:latest
            ${{ env.GATEWAY_IMAGE }}:${{ github.sha }}

####################################################
# DEPLOY
####################################################
